categories.main_business_segments: Hanshow Technology primarily operates in the retail digitalization sector, focusing on electronic shelf label (ESL) systems, SaaS cloud platform services, and related hardware products. The company offers comprehensive smart retail solutions including ESL terminals, wireless communication base stations, self-checkout terminals, AIoT products, and digital energy solutions for retail stores.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technology is based on proprietary IoT wireless communication protocols, specifically the High-density Low Power Cellular Network (HiLPC) protocol, which supports high concurrency, low power consumption, and strong anti-interference capabilities. Hanshow develops electronic paper display (EPD) and LCD display ESLs, integrates cloud computing, AI, and big data technologies, and employs an Integrated Product Development (IPD) model for R&D. Production mainly involves outsourced manufacturing with some in-house production of electronic paper display modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanshow serves primarily large retail chains and supermarkets globally, including major clients such as Auchan, Ahold, Aldi, Woolworths, Leroy Merlin, Metcash, China Resources Vanguard, and Duoduo Group. Its solutions target the retail industry, focusing on digital transformation of physical stores to improve pricing, inventory management, and customer experience.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with subsidiaries and operations in over 70 countries, including key markets in Europe (France, Germany, Netherlands, Spain, Poland), Asia-Pacific (China, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Australia, New Zealand), North America (USA, Canada), and the UK. It has established localized sales and service networks to support global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanshow operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and sales of electronic shelf labels and digital retail solutions. It sources components and modules from suppliers but controls key technology development and system integration, positioning itself as a solution provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in IoT wireless communication, AIoT integration, and cloud-based SaaS platforms. Key R&D projects include next-generation ESL products with enhanced display and battery life, AI-enabled smart shopping carts and cameras, solar-powered ESLs, and digital energy management solutions. Hanshow aims to lead retail digitalization by expanding product lines, enhancing AI and big data capabilities, and developing sustainable, energy-efficient technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Hanshow generates revenue mainly through product sales of electronic shelf labels and related hardware, complemented by SaaS cloud platform subscriptions and technical services including installation, maintenance, and software support. The sales model includes direct sales to large customers and distributor sales for smaller regional clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanshow is positioned as a leading global player in the electronic shelf label industry, ranked first domestically in China and among the top three worldwide. It competes with established international ESL providers such as SES-imagotag. The company leverages its proprietary communication protocols, rapid product iteration, and global localized service to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hanshow achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 4.49 billion, representing an 18.84% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 710 million, up 4.81%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 5.18 billion, growing nearly 37% from the prior year. Cash flow from operations increased by 62.29%, reflecting strong operational performance and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanshow differentiates itself through its proprietary HiLPC wireless communication protocol enabling high-density, low-power, and interference-resistant ESL networks. Its product portfolio includes advanced electronic paper and LCD ESLs with long battery life and superior display quality. The company offers integrated SaaS cloud platforms for scalable deployment and management, combined with AIoT smart retail devices that enhance operational efficiency and customer experience. Its global localized service and strategic partnerships with major retailers further strengthen its value proposition.
